name: zTopMax
expr: max(if(oT, 0 mm, height), if(oL, 0 mm, zL1), if(oR, 0 mm, zR1))

name: zBotMin
expr: min(if(oB, height, 0 mm), if(oL, height, zL0), if(oR, height, zR0))

name: yMin
expr: min(if(oL, width, 0 mm), if(oT, width, yT0), if(oB, width, yB0))

name: yMax
expr: max(if(oR, 0 mm, width), if(oT, 0 mm, yT1), if(oB, 0 mm, yB1))

name: secZc
expr: (aL * (zL0 + zL1) / 2 + aR * (zR0 + zR1) / 2 + aT * (height - tTop / 2) + aB * tBot / 2) / secA

name: secYc
expr: (aL * tLeft / 2 + aR * (width - tRight / 2) + aT * (yT0 + yT1) / 2 + aB * (yB0 + yB1) / 2) / secA

name: secIy
expr: pL * tLeft * (zL1 - zL0)^3 / 12 + aL * ((zL0 + zL1) / 2 - secZc)^2 + pR * tRight * (zR1 - zR0)^3 / 12 + aR * ((zR0 + zR1) / 2 - secZc)^2 + pT * (yT1 - yT0) * tTop^3 / 12 + aT * (height - tTop / 2 - secZc)^2 + pB * (yB1 - yB0) * tBot^3 / 12 + aB * (tBot / 2 - secZc)^2

name: secIz
expr: pL * (zL1 - zL0) * tLeft^3 / 12 + aL * (tLeft / 2 - secYc)^2 + pR * (zR1 - zR0) * tRight^3 / 12 + aR * (width - tRight / 2 - secYc)^2 + pT * tTop * (yT1 - yT0)^3 / 12 + aT * ((yT0 + yT1) / 2 - secYc)^2 + pB * tBot * (yB1 - yB0)^3 / 12 + aB * ((yB0 + yB1) / 2 - secYc)^2

name: xSec
expr: xB0 + tBh / 2 + max(clrST, clrSB, clrSL, clrSR) + 0.5 mm

name: cRemT
expr: if(cOkT, choose(cutTop, 0 mm, cVT, cVT, cDT), 0 mm)

name: cRemB
expr: if(cOkB, choose(cutBottom, 0 mm, cVB, cVB, cDB), 0 mm)

name: cRemL
expr: if(cOkL, choose(cutLeft, 0 mm, cVL, cVL, cDL), 0 mm)

name: cRemR
expr: if(cOkR, choose(cutRight, 0 mm, cVR, cVR, cDR), 0 mm)

name: aWebNet
expr: aL + aR - pL * tLeft * cRemL - pR * tRight * cRemR

name: anyCut
expr: cRemT > 0 mm || cRemB > 0 mm || cRemL > 0 mm || cRemR > 0 mm

name: Jclosed
expr: 4 * Am^2 / ((width - tLeft / 2 - tRight / 2) * (1 / tTop + 1 / tBot) + (height - tTop / 2 - tBot / 2) * (1 / tLeft + 1 / tRight))

name: Jopen
expr: (pT * (yT1 - yT0) * tTop^3 + pB * (yB1 - yB0) * tBot^3 + pL * (zL1 - zL0) * tLeft^3 + pR * (zR1 - zR0) * tRight^3) / 3

name: tMaxWall
expr: max(pT * tTop, pB * tBot, pL * tLeft, pR * tRight)

name: sigCrTop
expr: if(oT, 1e9, if(cRemT > 0 mm, (0.425 + (cRimT / aCutT)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tTop / cRimT)^2, if(oL || oR, (0.425 + (wi / aPanel)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tTop / wi)^2, kT * kfac * Emat * (tTop / wi)^2)))

name: sigCrBot
expr: if(oB, 1e9, if(cRemB > 0 mm, (0.425 + (cRimB / aCutB)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tBot / cRimB)^2, if(oL || oR, (0.425 + (wi / aPanel)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tBot / wi)^2, kT * kfac * Emat * (tBot / wi)^2)))

name: sigCrWebL
expr: if(oL, 1e9, if(cRemL > 0 mm, (0.425 + (cRimL / aCutL)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tLeft / cRimL)^2, if(oT || oB, (0.425 + (hi / aPanel)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tLeft / hi)^2, 23.9 * kfac * Emat * (tLeft / hi)^2)))

name: sigCrWebR
expr: if(oR, 1e9, if(cRemR > 0 mm, (0.425 + (cRimR / aCutR)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tRight / cRimR)^2, if(oT || oB, (0.425 + (hi / aPanel)^2) * kfac * Emat * (tRight / hi)^2, 23.9 * kfac * Emat * (tRight / hi)^2)))

name: scOffset
expr: if(oL || oR, 3 * (wi + if(oL, tRight, tLeft) / 2)^2 * (tTop + tBot) / 2 / (6 * (wi + if(oL, tRight, tLeft) / 2) * (tTop + tBot) / 2 + (height - tTop / 2 - tBot / 2) * if(oL, tRight, tLeft)), 0 mm)

name: tabArea
expr: min(if(eTL, wTL * tbTL, 1 m * 1 m), if(eTR, wTR * tbTR, 1 m * 1 m), if(eBL, wBL * tbBL, 1 m * 1 m), if(eBR, wBR * tbBR, 1 m * 1 m))

name: Mmax_Nmm
expr: choose(support, load * length / 1 mm + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 2, load * length / 1 mm / 4 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 8, load * length / 1 mm / 8 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 12)

name: Vmax_N
expr: choose(support, load + qN_mm * length / 1 mm, (load + qN_mm * length / 1 mm) / 2, (load + qN_mm * length / 1 mm) / 2)

name: deflection
expr: (choose(support, load * (length / 1 mm)^3 / 3 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^4 / 8, load * (length / 1 mm)^3 / 48 + 5 * qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^4 / 384, load * (length / 1 mm)^3 / 192 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^4 / 384) / (Emat * Iy / (1 mm)^4) + choose(support, load * (length / 1 mm) + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 2, load * (length / 1 mm) / 4 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 8, load * (length / 1 mm) / 4 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 8) / (Gmat * (aL + aR) / (1 mm)^2)) * 1 mm

name: deflectionNet
expr: (choose(support, load * (length / 1 mm)^3 / 3 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^4 / 8, load * (length / 1 mm)^3 / 48 + 5 * qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^4 / 384, load * (length / 1 mm)^3 / 192 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^4 / 384) / (Emat * IyNet / (1 mm)^4) + choose(support, load * (length / 1 mm) + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 2, load * (length / 1 mm) / 4 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 8, load * (length / 1 mm) / 4 + qN_mm * (length / 1 mm)^2 / 8) / (Gmat * aWebNet / (1 mm)^2)) * 1 mm

name: twist_deg
expr: torque * 1000 * (length / 1 mm) * if(support == 1, 1, 0.25) / (Gmat * torsionJ / (1 mm)^4) * 180 / pi

name: twistOpen_deg
expr: torque * 1000 * (length / 1 mm) * if(support == 1, 1, 0.25) / (Gmat * Jopen / (1 mm)^4) * 180 / pi

name: tauTorsion_MPa
expr: if(openWall > 1 || anyCut, torque * 1000 * tMaxWall / Jopen * (1 mm)^3, torque * 1000 / (2 * Am / (1 mm)^2 * min(tTop, tBot, tLeft, tRight) / 1 mm))

name: bucklingReserve
expr: if(sigmaMax_MPa > 0, min(sigCrTop / max(sigmaTop_MPa, 1e-9), sigCrBot / max(sigmaBot_MPa, 1e-9), min(sigCrWebL, sigCrWebR) / sigmaMax_MPa), 999)

name: edgeTabUse_pct
expr: 100 * Vmax_N * max(aT * (height - tTop / 2 - zNeutral) / max(1, eTL + eTR), aB * (zNeutral - tBot / 2) / max(1, eBL + eBR)) / Iy * dT / (tabArea / (1 mm)^2 * fd / sqrt(3))

name: f1_Hz
expr: lam2 / (2 * pi) * sqrt(Emat * 1e6 * Iy / (1 mm)^4 * 1e-12 / (massKg / (length / 1 m)) / (length / 1 m)^4)
